claims.claim: The official MOESM10 workbook has 25 visible sheets and was analyzed read-only; its hash is unchanged.
claims.evidence: source_workbook_map.json; analyze_observable_interface.py rechecks SHA-256; SOURCE_MAP.md records sheets, ranges, grain, units, and limits.
claims.boundary: Structural source-data inventory only; no new measurements were collected.

claims.claim: The existing pairs (a_rho=a_phi=4, alpha=3.5e-6) and (a_rho=a_phi=8, alpha=1.934e-6) have nearly identical 0-8 h front secants while alpha differs by about 45% and the tail steepness doubles.
claims.evidence: Prior c8 high-resolution run at Nx=3200,Nt=25600; this lane's Nx=800,Nt=3200 replay gives 21.77463 and 21.77482 um/h.
claims.boundary: Only front-speed non-identifiability over this model family; not a failure of the authors' joint fit.

claims.claim: The conservative form of the published phenotype PDE gives candidate differentiated-species velocity v_B=V-D*phi_x/phi for phi>0.
claims.evidence: Multiply the fraction PDE by rho; D*(phi_xx+(rho_x/rho)*phi_x) becomes D*(rho*phi_x)_x, hence B-species flux rho*phi*V-D*rho*phi_x.
claims.boundary: Requires that tracked labeled cells represent this species flux; conversion sources and biological marker correspondence are not independently validated here.

claims.claim: Under the v_B observation map, 0-6 h model displacements from x=(0,-200,-400) are (65.20,47.16,25.65) um for the released pair and (110.90,51.26,14.12) um for the speed alias. A paired projection of the four source video-level x-displacement vectors has mean 43.02 um and descriptive t95 interval [7.06,78.98], versus model projections 60.83 and 108.14 um; the interval includes the released projection and excludes this alias.
claims.evidence: observable_interface_results.json; four dataset means from data_ex_vivo_tracked_cells_all.csv, with videos as independent units.
claims.boundary: Exploratory, in-sample separation of one named pair. The t interval assumes four independent video-level values and does not include mapping, model, or parameter uncertainty; no global identifiability or external validation claim.

claims.claim: Article Methods define Fig. 3C cell speed as a 2D endpoint-displacement norm divided by 6 h; the source Rmd overlays those nonnegative norms against the signed model V profile at its first stored slice t=0.
claims.evidence: Article Methods; Rmd lines 245-262 and time-index mapping at lines 153-157; workbook Fig3C!A1:E147.
claims.boundary: The plot establishes the authors' comparison convention, not exact identity of frame, direction, or time averaging. The lane does not refit alpha to those means.

claims.claim: Fig2D supplies 37 time-indexed GFP profiles with 3,532 pixel samples each, but its workbook axis is pixels and the file has no pixel-to-micrometre or GFP-to-phi calibration.
claims.boundary: The paper reports using GFP profiles in joint fitting; absence of calibration metadata from this workbook is not evidence that the authors' full fitting pipeline lacks a calibration.

claims.claim: Whether alpha and the initial tail are statistically or globally identifiable across plausible profile families remains unresolved.
claims.evidence: No calibrated fluorescence observation operator, joint error/likelihood model, broad parameter profile, or held-out condition was reconstructed in this lane.
claims.boundary: Do not promote the named-pair comparison into a general theorem or a corrected alpha estimate.
